description: Security rules for Java files — prevents SQL injection, field injection, hardcoded secrets, and System.exit

rules.description: No SQL built with string concatenation — SQL injection risk
rules.message: Building SQL with concatenation is vulnerable to injection — use PreparedStatement or JPA

rules.description: Avoid @Autowired field injection — prefer constructor injection
rules.message: @Autowired field injection makes testing harder — use constructor injection instead

secrets.description: No hardcoded secrets in Java files

rules.description: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords
rules.message: Hardcoded secret detected — use @Value('${...}') or a secrets manager

rules.description: No System.exit() — terminates the JVM unexpectedly
rules.message: System.exit() terminates the entire JVM — throw an exception or use a lifecycle hook
